repo_prior_art.cite: none; stat_transported_late_strength_frontier concerns weak IV strength and finite-cell transport, not a continuous polynomial-boundary regression frontier

published_prior_art.cite: KhanTamer2010 establishes irregular inverse-weight rates generally; ZhangLiuWangTeng2025 assumes a source density bounded below and a bounded likelihood ratio.
BurmanGamaloGhosalKundu2026 proves regular RiCOT under bounded density ratio; OriharaKomukaiLi2026 is observational ATE extrapolation rather than two-sample transported boundary regression.

repo_prior_art.cite: stat_transported_late_strength_frontier — compact confidence-set length for transported IV, not this Hölder transport-mean risk phase diagram

published_prior_art.cite: No inspected paper gives the stated matched two-sample polynomial-boundary phase diagram, including the a=1 logarithm.
ArmstrongKolesar2020 supplies fixed-class bias-aware local-polynomial intervals and MaWang2020 supplies weak-overlap IPW inference, but neither covers the stated learned two-sample transport process.
CaiLow2004 supplies the ordered-modulus framework but not the weighted transported-functional modulus at this boundary.
Bull2012 studies self-similar function bands under regular observation norms; no inspected result treats joint a,s adaptation for this two-sample transported functional.

soundness_flags.label: def:model-class; def:minimax-risk; thm:minimax-lower through thm:nonadaptation
soundness_flags.one_line: The class is declared as observed-law triples (P_S,P_T,D), but membership invokes unmodeled potential outcomes and tau; define a full-data law with observed-data projections, or define tau directly as the observed-law functional.

soundness_flags.label: ass:sample-balance; def:model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The finite-index class M_{n,m} includes m/n→kappa, a property of an entire sequence rather than a law at fixed (n,m); formulate the model over triangular arrays or keep balance outside each finite minimax class.

soundness_flags.label: def:spliced-estimator; thm:ricot-attainment
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposed RiCOT estimator is not a unique mathematical procedure: the transport cost, entropic and source-relaxation parameters, spline basis/knots, J_n schedule, feasibility rule, and tie-breaking are unspecified.

soundness_flags.label: def:bias-envelope; thm:fixed-class-honesty
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed envelope uses C_LP M h^{s+1}, although mu=mu_1-mu_0 may have Hölder radius 2M under the stated armwise assumptions; correct the radius and specify the missing J dependence of B_h and I_h.

soundness_flags.label: ass:residual-nondegeneracy
soundness_flags.one_line: Its upper bound Var(Y|A=d,X=x)≤M is implied by Y∈[0,1] and M>4; retain only the lower nondegeneracy requirement unless a sharper upper moment condition is intended.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:sharp-frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The asserted frontier is conditional on the one-dimensional polynomial source-boundary class, bounded outcomes, known randomized propensity, and prespecified indices.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Sharp minimax root-risk characterization only over the repaired observed/full-data version of M_{n,m}(a,s,t), not for multivariate boundaries or observational assignment.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:fixed-class-honesty and oeq:self-similar-adaptation
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Fixed-class inference prespecifies (a,s,t,M); adaptation is not claimed outside the explicit self-similar subclass.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Honesty is fixed-class, while joint adaptation remains conditional on M^{ss}_{n,m}(a,s,t) and is an open-ended target.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes a bounded target-to-trial density ratio and identifies that ratio as the L2 Riesz representer in its regular semiparametric analysis.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1–4, model class V and Definition 1; p. 4, Theorem 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper requires the source density to be bounded below and above and the likelihood ratio to be uniformly B-bounded, then gives a moment-estimation lower bound and logarithmically slack two-stage attainment.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 7–10, Sections 3.1–3.2 and Remark 1; pp. 14–15, Section 4.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies observational ATE recovery by polynomial extrapolation across weighted ATEs and assumes its polynomial approximation remainder is ignorable; it does not state a Hölder boundary transport result.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1–2, Introduction; pp. 7–8, Theorem 1; pp. 14–16, Sections 3.2–3.3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives Gaussian and non-Gaussian trimmed-IPW regimes and combines subsampling with local-polynomial trimming-bias correction.
The paper links arbitrarily large inverse weights required for point identification to irregular, tail-dependent slower-than-parametric rates.
The paper constructs honest scalar nonparametric-regression intervals using bias-aware fixed-length critical values and local-polynomial estimators.
The paper characterizes adaptive confidence intervals for linear functionals through between-class and ordered moduli.

source_verification_receipts.version: Electronic Journal of Statistics 6, published version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes self-similarity as necessary and sufficient for honest adaptive confidence bands in its regular Hölder models.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Recast the model as full-data triangular arrays with explicit observed-data projections, define tau as the identified integral functional, and separate finite-(n,m) minimax classes from the m/n→kappa asymptotic regime.

Make the RiCOT construction executable: name the transport cost and penalties, knot/basis family, deterministic J_n, feasibility and tie-breaking, then derive its stability without imposing a fitted-weight rate; state any required relation between density smoothness t and the claimed rate.

Repair the interval envelope by using the Hölder radius actually implied for mu, indexing B and I by J, and state a uniform variance/normal-approximation route for the random calibration residual envelope.
Add exact theorem/page anchors for the RICOT bounded-overlap endpoint and Zhang et al.'s uniformly bounded-ratio class to the per-statement gaps.

recommended_next_step: Revise the statistical model and fully specify the estimator and interval before Stage 0; the matched polynomial-boundary frontier remains a genuinely novel, potentially flagship kernel after those repairs.
